matches.rationale: The finding identifies exactly the same locus (f^{return} definition in Section 3.1) and the same inconsistency: the negative-advantage sign contradicts the claim that maximizing f^{return} increases probability of better-than-average actions, and even formally refutes the monotonicity claim in Lean.
No finding addresses the missing learning rate η_j in the influence score formula or the inconsistent use of θ_j^{(k)} vs θ_0^{(k)}; the single finding is entirely about the f^{return} sign issue.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Correctly detects the sign inconsistency in f^{return} and its contradiction with the stated claim about the objective's effect.
